architecture: Siamese ResNet-50 (ImageNet), emb128, |ea-eb| head, BCE (Packhauser 2022 arch, reimpl)
note: License-clean reimplementation of Packhauser et al. 2022 (refpaper 111) verification architecture, trained on CheXpert shadow patients (NOT their ChestX-ray14 checkpoint). Published ceilings for context: their verification AUC 0.994 (ChestX-ray14), 0.987 (CheXpert cross-dataset). plaintext = strong-attacker ceiling here; ciphertext conditions test whether the anonymized latent view defeats this stronger attacker. S2 expected ~random.
